attire_id_scheme.rule: default attire = characterId*100 (XXX00); alt2 = XXX10; alt3 = XXX20; alt5 = XXX40; vacant-slot example: slot 1013 -> default 101300
attire_id_scheme.charactermapping_record: [attire-ID little-endian][8-byte main character-folder hash][8-byte attire-folder hash]; Kane example hashes from tutorial: main folder 6200D2B087B1E360, default attire folder 903510F1B4D300ED
attire_id_scheme.slot_add_rule: No tool appends to charactermapping.jsfb: to place a model in an unused slot, REPLACE an alternate/unused attire hash; the replaced slot's old model must also change or the game reads a duplicate ID.

file_layout_2k20_2k22.per_character: one folder per character spread across baked files; folder identity = path-derived hash ID shown in Caketools
file_layout_2k20_2k22.profile: .pofo — wrestler information (nameplate string IDs in endian, attributes, DLC/attitude/crowd-balance/gender flags per Genesis/Data Editor usage)
file_layout_2k20_2k22.moveset: .moveset — moveset AND entrance AND victory AND manager/team/attire-selection data in one file (per 2K20 Data Breakdown: .moveset contains actual moveset + entrance + victory + managers + team + attire info)
file_layout_2k20_2k22.difference_from_2k19: 2K19: .pac model files in pac\ch + CCT chunk0.def regen. 2K20/2K22: CAK folder layout + charactermapping hashes; chunk0.def flow does NOT apply.

moveset_categories_18_note: Genesis documents 18 move categories for its 2K19 moveset editor; the 2K20/2K22 Data Editor exposes the same category family (standing/grapple/ground/turnbuckle/aerial/irish-whip/double-team/taunt/special). The 18 names above are the WH wire labels for that family; the per-slot numeric IDs inside a real .moveset file are NOT asserted here — they come from a Data Editor dump on an owned install (active path, see blockers).
